units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 9:8">Targ. I Sam. IX, 8</cite> (h. text <he>רבע שקל</he>).—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 12a:11">Kidd. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>קום כ״ד בז׳</he> twenty four Isar went on a Zuz: when the Isar was reduced, <he>קום ל״ב ז׳</he> thirty two Isar went &c.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 66b:21">Sabb. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ חיורא</he> a new silver coin; <cite ref="Pesachim 74b:4">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00061"><he>זְגוּגִיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chagigah 5a:17">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>ז׳ לעללא וכ׳</he> a Zuz for provision is not on hand, but for (saving from) hanging it is, i.e. charity often waits for the extremest distress.

B. Kam. 11ᵃ (prov.) כשורא במתא בז׳ וכ׳ a joist in town costs a Zuz, a joist in the woods the same, i.e. the cost of transportation has no influence on the price; a. fr.—Pl. זוּזִין, זוּזֵי; also in gen. money. Targ. II Esth. I, 8; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63b:3">B. Mets. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>אי הוו לי ז׳ וכ׳</he> if I had money.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ז׳ דאינשי וכ׳</he> people’s money does the brokership for them (with cash in hand you need no broker); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 65b">Ib. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>זוּזָאַי</he> the money due to me.—
Keth. 65ᵇ; 67ᵃ ז׳ פשיטי (= ז׳ מדינה) country Zuz, one eighth of the town Zuz (or Tyrian) in value; (v. Zuckerman Münzen, Jahresber. des Jüd. Theol. Seminars, Breslau 1862, p. 6; p. 24).
